focus: The editor lane built the first real scene and it does not assemble. Two faults, both mine, both understood. Waiting on your go to fix.
nextBoundary: Still clean - nothing running. Next boundary is after the two-fix parcel lands and the editor lane reruns.

queue.title: The generated background-animation table names its data blob in a form the assembler will not accept. The fix is proven and one line of the generator; this is the code path our own notes said had never once been exercised, and the first real scene exercised it.

With that fixed the build gets further and stops again: the background-animation block grew from four bytes to eight kilobytes and now runs through the block placed after it. A placement decision against the frozen tables - NOT the deferred order row, which is a different block and has not fired.

The same defect as the one just fixed, on the two fields beside it: the vertical centre and offset are unbounded on both sides, so a value the editor accepts is unbuildable at the end. The precedent for who moves is now settled, so this can be derived and landed rather than parked.

A negative generator parameter emits a label with a minus sign in it, which is not a legal name - the author spells the scene right and the error points at generated code. Establish whether any generator legitimately takes a negative before deciding if this is live or merely ugly.
The alignment-attribute migration owed to sigil - two scene fields take the attribute, two hand-written checks delete. Unblocked; verify the built binary carries the feature at dispatch.
Re-run the 19 effects gates. NOTE: they never needed the shared emulator - each spawns its own, so a re-baseline would pass vacuously. Needs re-scoping before it is worth running.
